host: macOS Darwin 25.5 arm64, Mac16,10, 10 logical CPUs, 16 GiB memory
scenario: A solution tsconfig references two projects. The entry is initially claimed by the second project; changing the first project's config makes it claim the entry and changes the selected transform config.
change: Changed projects/a/tsconfig.json to include ../../src/**/* and target ES2020.

observed.result: Editing the previously nonselected project config restarted the CLI and reloaded the entry in the same PID.

implementation_facts: Watch ancestor tsconfig candidates and their extends/reference chains because edits can change which project claims a loaded source.
Treat tracked TypeScript config metadata as restart-only.
